inputThis:
$:set -euo pipefail
mkdir -p conversations
cat > conversations/conversation-record.template.json <<'JSON_TEMPLATE_EOF'
{
  "template_id": "terminals.conversation-record",
  "template_version": "1.0.0",
  "task_type": "user_prompt_and_agent_response_contextual_analysis",
  "created_at_utc": null,
  "target_exchange": {
    "verbatim_utterance": null,
    "summary_of_adjacent_conversation": {
      "preceding_user_turn_count": null,
      "preceding_user_turns_chronological": [],
      "immediate_preceding_agent_response": null,
      "sequence_summary": null
    },
    "key_context_clues_to_meaning_and_intent": [],
    "explanation_of_how_utterance_is_embedded_in_conversation": null
  },
  "agent_response": {
    "summary": null,
    "key_context_clues_to_response_intent": [],
    "terms_or_explanations_risking_false_impressions": [],
    "relationship_to_preceding_user_prompt_and_recent_exchanges": {
      "immediate_user_prompt": null,
      "immediate_relationship": null,
      "recent_user_prompts_and_agent_responses": [],
      "outcome_assessment": null
    }
  }
}
JSON_TEMPLATE_EOF
cat > conversations/README.json <<'JSON_README_EOF'
{
  "document_type": "directory-readme",
  "version": "1.0.0",
  "directory": "conversations/",
  "purpose": "Temporarily house conversation records for specification design and analysis.",
  "status": "temporary",
  "record_type": "user_prompt_and_agent_response_contextual_analysis",
  "current_template": {
    "path": "conversations/conversation-record.template.json",
    "version": "1.0.0",
    "template_id": "terminals.conversation-record"
  },
  "source_example": {
    "path_in_chatgpt_library": "/Plugin Design 1/Tasks/User Prompt Task Queue/user-prompt-task-1794191751.json",
    "library_file_id": "libfile_f45fc8bd3bf081918fea24ec6ed5d0c0"
  },
  "constraints": {
    "preceding_user_turns": {
      "minimum": 3,
      "maximum": 7,
      "order": "chronological"
    },
    "verbatim_utterance": "exact user wording",
    "evidence": "distinguish verified actions from claims; identify ambiguities likely to mislead",
    "long_term_status": "not an authoritative permanent archive"
  },
  "lifecycle": "Records may be reviewed and migrated to an eventual permanent location; preserve provenance and original content during transfer."
}
JSON_README_EOF
node -e "const fs=require('fs');for(const p of ['conversations/conversation-record.template.json','conversations/README.json']) JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(p,'utf8'))"
for name in conversation-record.template.json README.json; do
  path="conversations/$name"
  if gh api "repos/BestNameYet/Terminals/contents/$path" --silent 2>/dev/null; then
    echo "EXISTS_UNEXPECTEDLY:$path"
    exit 3
  fi
  echo "Publishing:$path"
  gh api --method PUT "repos/BestNameYet/Terminals/contents/$path" -f message="docs: add machine-readable conversation records $name" -f content="$(base64 -w0 "$path")" -f branch=main --jq '.commit.sha'
done
echo "REMOTE_FILE_SUMMARY"
for name in conversation-record.template.json README.json; do
  gh api "repos/BestNameYet/Terminals/contents/conversations/$name" --jq '[.path,.sha,.size] | @json'
done
